title: Record evaluator shutdown, control-plane, batch, connector, and incident contracts without adopting provider authority
problem: OpenAI Evals became read-only; Anthropic connectors had incomplete-read incidents; Kimi introduced a consequence-bearing Admin API and expanded asynchronous Batch contracts. Decide whether to amend protocol law, adopt or migrate, record evidence only, or make no repository change.
baseline: Default routes are local-first. DALEOBANKS alone retains optional legacy OpenAI Chat Completions and embeddings. No Kimi Admin/Batch, OpenAI Evals, Anthropic connector runtime, or provider-owned scheduler was found. Draft PR 105 section 7 already governs leased provider state, exact contracts, receipts, retry, cost, evaluation, credentials/data scope, and duplicate runtimes.

alternatives.name: Evidence-only update
alternatives.description: Add the dated packet and this deliberation; change no protocol text or runtime.
advantages: Preserves hard dates and new contracts
disadvantages: Does not verify live provider behavior
alternatives.revival_evidence: Selected because a control plane, async contract, and effective evaluator transition cross the materiality gate.

alternatives.name: Vendor-specific protocol amendment
alternatives.description: Add named Kimi Admin/Batch and OpenAI Evals clauses.
disadvantages: Couples constitutional text to volatile products
alternatives.revival_evidence: A deterministic failure demonstrates an uncovered invariant.

alternatives.name: Immediate adoption or migration
alternatives.description: Adopt Kimi Admin/Batch or migrate Evals now.
advantages: Could add visibility, lower batch rates, or evaluation continuity
disadvantages: No route, account inventory, residency proof, independent benchmark, or founder authorization exists
alternatives.revival_evidence: Founder-approved sandbox with pinned contracts, least privilege, independent acceptance, cost ceiling, and rollback.

alternatives.name: Provider-native control and execution plane
alternatives.description: Let provider admin, batch, connectors, and evaluation own workflow state.
disadvantages: Violates canonical authority, one-source-of-truth, evaluator independence, and no-duplicate-runtime constraints
alternatives.revival_evidence: None while UNIIMENTE requires one canonical authority, task, receipt, evidence, cost, and consequence plane.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Brief the user and leave PR 105 unchanged.
disadvantages: Loses durable control-plane, batch, and Evals transition evidence

roles.position: Keep providers as replaceable adapters; admin roles, queues, and evaluators cannot manufacture authority.
material_concerns: Control-plane convenience can redefine project authority
Migration urgency can bypass human review

roles.position: Model admin calls, connector reads, eval runs, batches, items, and retries as subordinate attempts with canonical receipts.
material_concerns: Async partial completion is not replay-equivalent
Provider queues and admin automation can become a second runtime

roles.position: Make no repository change because direct exposure is negative and existing section 7 is sufficient.
material_concerns: Five role prompts are one model's self-review
Kimi Batch publication day is unstated
evidence_refs: Negative searches on four default branches

roles.position: Record effective dates and recovery semantics; build no adapter until authorized exposure exists.
material_concerns: Admin authorization cache and endpoint-specific writes complicate recovery
Batch expiry, partial output, cache writes, and retries hide cost
evidence_refs: Provider docs and status histories 2026-10-27 through 2026-11-03

roles.position: Treat provider audit, billing, connector, search, upload, and eval results as bounded evidence requiring independent reconciliation.
material_concerns: Admin data includes members, billing, usage, and audit history
Connector failure can silently omit personal or organizational records

evidence.claim: OpenAI Evals became read-only on October 31 and is scheduled to shut down November 30.
evidence.finding: The effective read-only transition occurred in the review window; default-branch searches found no direct exposure.

evidence.claim: Anthropic connectors returned errors during the review window.
evidence.finding: Gmail and Calendar connector incidents resolved October 28; no repository connector integration was found.

evidence.claim: Kimi introduced a beta organization control plane on November 2.
evidence.finding: It manages membership, projects, inference keys, billing, usage, and audit data through separate admin credentials and scoped permissions.

evidence.claim: Kimi expanded Batch to K3/K3.1 with asynchronous, discounted, cache-write, and expiry semantics.
evidence.finding: The entry is labeled October 2026 without a publication day; direct exposure is negative.

evidence.claim: Current default branches have no direct exposure to the newly material features.
evidence.reference: Exact GitHub searches at Kernel d64a6c93, DALEOBANKS 667439f4, WMI ec82b802, PumpStation db6758df on 2026-11-03
evidence.finding: No Kimi Admin/Batch, OpenAI Evals/Promptfoo, or Anthropic connector runtime was found; DALEOBANKS retains optional legacy OpenAI calls only.

counterevidence.claim: New constitutional protocol text is necessary.
counterevidence.finding: Existing provider-neutral rules already cover all material invariants.

counterevidence.reference: No provider account, credential, contract, or live call was accessed
counterevidence.finding: All integration behavior remains prospective and unverified.

pass_1.intended_outcome: Preserve one canonical, retry-safe, independently evaluated, privacy- and cost-bounded collaboration runtime while recording actionable provider deadlines and contracts.

advantages.statement: The dated evidence captures a hard evaluator transition and a new consequence-bearing control plane.
advantages.amplified_value: Future owners can migrate or reject features from official contracts without adopting them now.

advantages.statement: Provider-neutral rules absorb new products without constitutional churn.
advantages.amplified_value: Canonical authority remains stable as vendors change control and execution surfaces.

disadvantages.statement: Another weekly record increases review debt.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Add two unique evidence files and one bounded PR-body delta only.

disadvantages.statement: No new feature is directly exposed on current default branches.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Label exposure negative and defer code until an authorized inventory or proposal reveals use.

disadvantages.statement: Admin writes and async batch completion can produce ambiguous effects.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Require canonical operation/item identities, receipts, preconditions, and reconciliation before retry.

disadvantages.statement: Admin credentials and connector data widen identity, billing, audit, and personal-data scope.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Perform no account action; require separate least-privilege authorization, residency/retention review, revocation, and deletion tests.

disadvantages.statement: Evaluator migration can silently change case and grader semantics.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Export immutable cases, retain stable IDs and full contracts, and compare independently before promotion.

disadvantages.statement: Kimi Batch lacks a stated publication day.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Record the provider's month and the observation date; do not invent a day.

comparisons.baseline: Local-first defaults, optional legacy OpenAI calls, no Anthropic/Kimi route, generic provider controls.
comparisons.do_nothing: Avoids review debt but loses durable evaluator, control-plane, and batch evidence.
comparisons.simplest_viable_alternative: User brief only; sufficient for incidents but weak for the hard Evals transition and Kimi control/batch contract lineage.
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: Provider admin, batch, connectors, and eval services own state and scheduling; convenient but incompatible with canonical authority and evaluator independence.
comparisons.reversible_experiment: If authorized, replay frozen admin/batch/eval fixtures offline, then run a cost-capped sandbox with no external effect and independent acceptance.

rejected_alternatives.name: Add vendor-specific law
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: A deterministic failure proves an uncovered invariant.

rejected_alternatives.name: Adopt or migrate now
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: No authorized route, account inventory, residency proof, benchmark, or founder approval exists.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: Authorized need plus pinned fixtures, least privilege, independent evaluation, cost review, and rollback.

rejected_alternatives.name: Inspect accounts or credentials
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: This review lacks authority to access provider accounts, secrets, balances, projects, or contracts.

pass_2.attack_summary: The evidence-only design can still become bureaucracy, overstate one-model review, rely on mutable provider pages, miss non-repository use, or permit wildcard admin scope and hidden async cost.

new_weaknesses.statement: The recurring draft may become harder to review than the risk.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Keep this cycle to two evidence files and one body section; no protocol or code change.

new_weaknesses.statement: Five role perspectives are one model's self-review.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Keep draft status and require founder or delegated independent human review.

new_weaknesses.statement: Provider docs, status, and prices can change after observation.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Preserve dates, URLs, exact branch SHAs, and require a fresh check before implementation.

new_weaknesses.statement: Batch discounts can hide cache-write, retry, expiry, and duplicate-submission cost.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Reconcile every item and attempt; kill adoption when total cost is incomplete.

new_weaknesses.statement: An admin wildcard scope may silently expand with future API scopes.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Prohibit wildcard scope and provider-side policy automation without founder authorization and least-privilege fixtures.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Next cycle; brief-only unless materiality is met

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: No adapter or migration is built until authorized exposure exists.
Canonical receipts, preconditions, and per-item reconciliation are required before any retry.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Any admin write, batch expiry, partial output, timeout, or unknown state

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: No account, credential, project, member, billing, audit, mailbox, calendar, or residency action occurs in this review.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Any identity, admin, connector, or account task

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Migration requires stable cases, full contract capture, and independent comparison before promotion.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Any non-repository OpenAI Evals inventory or replacement proposal

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: The record distinguishes the October label from the November 3 observation date.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: A dated Kimi notice or changed batch contract

pass_2.final_design: Add only the 2026-11-03 official-source evidence packet and validated deliberation to draft PR 105; leave section 7 and all runtime, routes, accounts, credentials, production, authority, and default branches unchanged.

residual_risks.mitigation: Require a separate authorized inventory before the November 30 Evals shutdown or any adoption.
residual_risks.review_trigger: Suspected OpenAI Evals use or provider adoption

residual_risks.risk: The deliberation is not independent approval.
residual_risks.mitigation: Keep draft status and require founder or delegated human decision.

residual_risks.risk: Provider contracts can change after capture.
residual_risks.mitigation: Recheck official sources and pin fixtures before any canary.

dissent.handling: Preserve the brief-only objection. It controls scope: no protocol text, runtime code, fixture, provider call, account inspection, or migration. The Kimi control plane, async batch contract, and OpenAI Evals effective transition justify only dated evidence.

entries.position: Make no repository change because direct exposure is negative and existing rules are sufficient.
entries.rationale: Recurring model-authored records can create bureaucracy and de facto policy authority.
entries.evidence_threshold: Future updates require direct exposure, a hard effective transition, breaking contract, material incident, or uncovered invariant.
entries.review_trigger: Founder review or next weekly cycle

migration_plan: No runtime migration. If exposure is authorized, pin provider/model/API/region/tool/admin/evaluator contracts; translate every operation, batch item, connector read, retry, and cost into canonical attempts and receipts; prove idempotency and recovery with deterministic fixtures; perform independent evaluation and credential/retention/residency/cost review; then run a founder-approved sandbox canary.

steps: Leave draft PR 105 unmerged or revert only the 2026-11-03 evidence commits
Preserve evidence and dissent as historical records
Return to brief-only reporting for immaterial cycles

kill_criteria: Any default-branch write or unapproved merge
Any account, credential, production, routing, spending, or authority change
Any provider-owned canonical identity, policy, task, evidence, evaluator, receipt, retry, cost, queue, scheduler, or runtime
Any wildcard or unreviewed admin scope
Any retry or failover without receipt and idempotency reconciliation
Any duplicate batch item or external effect
Any migration treated as replay-equivalent without frozen cases and independent evaluation
Any ineligible region, retention, residency, or data scope
Any missing cache-write, expiry, retry, or duplicate-submission cost
review_trigger: Founder review of PR 105; any Kimi Admin/Batch proposal; any non-repository OpenAI Evals use before 2026-11-30; or an incident with ambiguous completion
